closing a failed download leaves an unhandled rejection

browser_runs.input: synthetic SVG/PNG, grid project and CLI-generated manual garment pattern

checks.name: sidebar lists the gauge first and groups the existing-work entries
whole-grid colour replacement updates downloads and supports undo and redo
upload PNG and prepare local photo review
embedded canvas add/erase/undo/reset reaches the Streamlit app
complete subject/proportion/parts review and generate
result page folds sources by default and moves coordinates into the structure JSON
marker styles and repeated progress changes preserve the open, full-width part panel
download backup/JSON/Markdown/PDF and compare actual contents
legacy custom structure IDs survive import, rendering and backup export
unrecognized review markers remain in backup without false confirmation
placeholder colors are clear in the result and Markdown while backup values stay unchanged
first history save, undo and save keep the same stored record
project download contains the current progress and personal notes
manual-to-photo history load keeps two pages progress/notes isolated
fresh browser context restores project, then re-exports identical work
invalid import preserves the active project, progress and notes
preview exact 16-stitch head opening, restore project in new context, then close again
independent 26x28 hat with 30x32 body, unchanged work, trial gate and fresh project recovery
weighed 30x32 sample stays bound after trial default changes to 26x28, with fixed hat and fresh recovery
material preview/cancel/apply and unchanged material/size after undo retain redo, provenance, notes and progress
advanced JSON editors stay unmounted until the enable button is clicked
advanced JSON panel starts collapsed, keeps a draft through preview and cancel, and downloads stay applied until regeneration
colour panel previews the affected rounds and the worked-yarn notice, cancel is read-only, and apply/undo/redo keep stitches and completed rounds
per-copy colour reaches the Markdown export and survives a project restore with progress
colour panel renders inside a 390 px viewport without horizontal overflow
switching custom names restores their own swatches and shared display-colour changes are previewed
custom display swatch stays with its name through Markdown, PDF, Parade, undo, redo and project restore
legacy collision requires recovery, then separate copy progress survives a fresh project restore
390 px viewport keeps the title on one line and the header opaque without Deploy
390 px viewport opens the sidebar drawer with the same gauge-first outline
